create_greedy_distribution: create a Greedy distribution from unnormalized preference scores using JAX arrays
sample_greedy_distribution: sample actions from a Greedy distribution that selects among optimal preference indices
access_greedy_preferences: access the unnormalized preferences stored in a Greedy distribution via the preferences property
index_greedy_distribution: index into a batched Greedy distribution to extract a subset of preference distributions
compute_argmax_tie_breaking: compute uniform probabilities over tied maximum preference values using argmax with random tie breaking
